steps.message: Quick one-liner: bump the session timeout from 30 minutes to 8 hours in config.js. Just change the value, nothing fancy.

arguments.command: cat config.js; ls; grep -rn "timeout\|Timeout\|SESSION" --include=*.js . | grep -v node_modules
grep -n "SESSION\|imeout" server.js; sed -i '' 's/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30,/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,/' config.js && grep -n SESSION config.js
arguments.description: Check usage and update timeout value

steps.message: I changed `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` in `config.js` from `30` to `480`, which is 8 hours. The setting is in minutes, so that's the right value. The only other place that uses it is a log line in `server.js`, and that picks up the new value without any change. I haven't committed anything.
